title: A Leap Forward in the Coordination Chemistry of N-Hydroxy-1,8-naphthalimide Chelate: New {Dy2} and {Dy5} Single-Molecule Magnets and the Structure-Directing Role of Supporting β-Diketonate Ligands

material_class.structural_family: dinuclear Dy2 complex with N-hydroxy-1,8-naphthalimide and dipivaloylmethanate ligands

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid Dy(dpm)3·2H2O (0.10 mmol, 0.075 g) was added to a stirred orange solution of hynadH (0.10 mmol, 0.021 g) and NEt3 (0.10 mmol, 0.014 mL) in MeCN (6 mL) and DMF (6 mL). The resulting yellow solution was stirred for 30 min and filtered. Slow evaporation of the filtrate at room temperature afforded pale yellow plate-like crystals of 1 after 4 days. The crystals were collected by filtration, washed with cold MeCN (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 2 mL), and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate slowly evaporated at room temperature to give pale yellow plate-like crystals; washed with cold MeCN (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 2 mL) and dried in air

properties.summary: Dinuclear SMM. χMT = 28.17 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (0.1 T), decreasing to 15.38 cm3 mol−1 K at 2.0 K. Magnetization does not saturate at 7 T. Frequency- and temperature-dependent ac χM″ peaks below ~15 K under zero dc field. Combined QTM/Raman/Orbach fit (2–15 K) gives Ueff = 100.27(7) K, τ0 = 9.9(2)×10−4 s, n = 5.66(3), C = 1.56×10−3 s−1 K−n, τQTM = 0.139 s.

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; QTM + Raman + Orbach fit of τ(T) between 2–15 K

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid Dy(tta)3·2H2O (0.10 mmol, 0.086 g) was added to a stirred orange solution of hynadH (0.10 mmol, 0.021 g) and NEt3 (0.10 mmol, 0.014 mL) in MeCN (8 mL) and DMF (4 mL). The resulting yellow solution was stirred for 30 min and filtered. Slow evaporation of the filtrate at room temperature afforded yellow plate-like crystals of 2·2DMF after 4 days. The crystals were collected by filtration, washed with cold MeCN (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 2 mL), and dried in air.

properties.summary: Dinuclear SMM. χMT = 28.21 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (0.1 T), decreasing to 19.30 cm3 mol−1 K at 2.0 K. Well-resolved frequency-dependent ac χM″ peaks under zero dc field. Full QTM/Raman/Orbach analysis was not reasonable; Orbach-only fit over 6–10 K gives Ueff = 19.63(2) K and τ0 = 1.7(2)×10−5 s, lower than for 1.

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid Dy(hfac)3·2H2O (0.10 mmol, 0.082 g) was added to a stirred orange solution of hynadH (0.10 mmol, 0.021 g) and NEt3 (0.10 mmol, 0.014 mL) in MeCN (6 mL) and MeOH (6 mL). The resulting pale-yellow solution was stirred for 30 min and filtered. Slow evaporation of the filtrate at room temperature afforded yellow rod-like crystals of 3 after 3 days. The crystals were collected by filtration, washed with cold MeCN (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 2 mL), and dried in air. Coordinated CF3CO2− groups are attributed to retro-Claisen condensation of hfac− under the basic conditions.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution reaction followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate slowly evaporated at room temperature to give yellow rod-like crystals; washed with cold MeCN (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 2 mL) and dried in air

properties.summary: Pentanuclear cluster with only weak tails of ac signals. χMT = 70.46 cm3 mol−1 K at 300 K (0.1 T), decreasing to 43.22 cm3 mol−1 K at 2.0 K. No χM″ peaks under zero or applied (400 Oe) dc field; only frequency-dependent low-T tails, consistent with fast QTM outside the SQUID frequency window.
